sentences.translation: Once upon a time, there was an old man and an old woman living in one place.
One day, my grandfather went to the mountain to mow the lawn.
Then a swarm was stealing the vegetables in the field.
The grandfather caught the tanuki and took it home.
When the old woman was preparing food in the kitchen, Tanuki said, "Grandma, my back hurts. Can you rub it?"
When the old woman rubbed her back, Tanuki deceived her and ran away.
Then the rabbit came to help him.
"Oh, my grandfather, I will kill you."
The rabbit went to Tanuki's house and said, "Tanuki, why don't you go to Mt. Kachikachi?"
"When you rub a tree, it's a mountain that makes a good sound of 'kachikachi'."
The Tanuki went to the mountain with the rabbit.
The rabbit said to Tanuki, "Please carry this luggage," and put a flint on the back of the Tanuki.
and the rabbit made a flaming stone, making a sound of "kachikachi."
Tanuki, who was hot on his back, went down the mountain, shouting, "Oh, my God!"
Tanuki finally received the reward for doing bad things.
